svg.aria-label: Structure of starch: amylose and amylopectin
svg.title: Structure of starch: amylose and amylopectin
svg.text: Structure of starch: amylose and amylopectin
AMYLOSE (20–30 %) — unbranched α-1,4 chain, coiled into a helix
AMYLOPECTIN (70–80 %) — branched: α-1,4 chains + α-1,6 branch points
● α-D-glucose unit ─ α(1→4) link ─ α(1→6) link at branch point (every ≈ 24–30 units)
I₂ → red-violet · branching makes it compact · glycogen is similar but branched every 8–12 units
